study_role: Development-confirmation density curve for intact and topic-subset RAG migrations

selection_rule.comparison: lexicographic per-condition comparison: Anytime@15, then restricted queries@15, then VSR@6
selection_rule.scope: select one global scheduler for all confirmation densities and scenarios

constraints: Fix 3000 same-domain clean documents within each replicate so only sentinel count changes along the main density curve
Use nested sentinel subsets of 15, 30, and 60 identities, corresponding to 0.498%, 0.990%, and 1.961% final-corpus density
Keep development and confirmation sentinel blocks disjoint
Choose one global scheduler using development blocks only and freeze it before confirmation execution
Use the same clean-document sample, sentinel identities, migration topics, retriever, model, and budget for every paired baseline-method comparison
Use original fixture plus first probe plus random scheduling as the SentinelRAG-style baseline
Use relation-explicit fixture plus failure-repair selection for every candidate method
Retain four of eight independently fitted corpus topics in the partial-migration scenario
Do not tune separately by density, dataset, retriever, target model, or scenario
Report all confirmation losses and the complete full-corpus 0.1% stress result alongside the main curve
Reject non-finite dense scores and use an explicitly audited einsum path instead of the unstable local BLAS matmul path
